title: Smooth localizations of the explicit Popescu auxiliary quotient
statement: Let $R,A,C$ be commutative rings, with compatible $R$-algebra structures on $A,C$ and an $A$-algebra structure on $C$. Let $\iota$ be a nonempty finite type, $k,m\geq0$, $f_j\in A[x_1,\ldots,x_k]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and $q:A[x_1,\ldots,x_k]\to C$ a surjective $A$-algebra map whose kernel is $(f_j)$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let $p\in A[x]$, and let $a_i\in A$ for $i\in\iota$. Assume $C_{q(p)}$ and every $A_{a_i}$ are smooth over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Define the actual quotient $B=A[x_k,y_i,z,t_{ij}]/(f_j-\sum_i y_i t_{ij},zy_i)$, with its induced $R$-algebra structure. Then $B_{z\bar p}$ and every $B_{a_i y_i}$ are smooth over $R$. Here $\bar p$ is the class of the inclusion of $p$. The index of $z$ is a universe lift of a singleton, so that $B$ has carrier in $\operatorname{Type}(\max(u,v))$ when $R:\operatorname{Type}(u)$ and $A,\iota:\operatorname{Type}(v)$. The carrier of $C$ is in the same maximum universe.

proof.text: Use the finite equivalence iota = Fin(card iota) and the lift equivalence for z to rename the polynomial variables. Evaluation on each x-generator shows that the renaming respects the inclusion of A[x]. Map the defining ideal: the f_j relations are preserved by reindexing the finite sum, and the zy_i relations by the finite equivalence. The quotient equivalence follows from Ideal.quotientEquivAlg.

proof.text: The presentation q induces Cp = A[x]/(f_j) isomorphic to C. Localize this equivalence at the class of p. Its image is q(p), so smoothness of C_(q(p)) transports to Cp_p. No object is selected from an unproved existence assertion.

proof.text: Apply the first auxiliary localization equivalence (the index type is nonempty, hence card(iota) >= 1). The recorded images of x imply, by polynomial homomorphism extensionality, that the class of p maps to its constant image in Cp[t,z]_z.

proof.text: The polynomial algebra Cp[t,z] is smooth over Cp, as is its localization at z. Base change this smooth map along Cp -> Cp_p, use the tensor-localization equivalence, and compose with the smooth map R -> Cp_p. Transport through the auxiliary equivalence and the iterated-localization equivalence to conclude that the standard auxiliary quotient localized at z*p is smooth over R.

proof.text: For each index i, the second auxiliary equivalence identifies B_(y_i) with a localized polynomial algebra over A. This is smooth over A. Base change along A -> A_(a_i), identify the tensor product with localization at the image of a_i, and compose with the assumed smooth map R -> A_(a_i). Iterated localization identifies the result with B_(a_i*y_i).

proof.text: Localize the renaming-induced quotient equivalence at z*p and at each a_i*y_i. Its images are exactly the elements in the stated explicit lifted quotient. Algebra.Smooth.of_equiv transports the two results. Empty x and f lists, zero a_i, zero q(p), and zero rings require no extra hypotheses.
